description: Authoritative catalog of Plain Damage sources in Granblue Fantasy, including summon calls, character abilities, ougi nukes, MC classes, and weapon mechanisms.

summons.name: Beelzebub (4★)
summons.conditions: Main Character Trance Level >= 2 (guaranteed at battle start when set as Main Summon, or gained via C.A.)
additionalUtility: Borehole (Trance Lv 3: 50% DEF Down + 100k Supplemental Damage for 1 turn)

summons.name: Belial (4★)
additionalUtility: Sub-aura adds up to 30,000 supplemental damage to all damage instances
Can grant team Double Strike, Unchallenged, or instant charge bar

summons.name: Michael (4★)
summons.conditions: Scales based on enemy current HP (up to 1,500,000 at 4★)

summons.name: The Tower (Arcarum SSR / 5★)
summons.conditions: Inflicts Tower of Destruction debuff dealing up to 1,000,000 plain damage at the end of each turn for 3 turns
additionalUtility: Passive DEF & Max HP sub-aura for Earth allies

summons.name: Grand Order (4★ / 5★)
summons.conditions: Deals plain damage to all foes on call

characters.name: Threo (Sarasa)
characters.conditions: Consumes 99% of current HP. Deals ~820,000 at base, ~1,230,000 at Lv 95, ~2,040,000 at Lv 130 Transcendence
characters.notes: Premier HP-scaling plain damage nuke; grants 100% Shield to protect low HP.

characters.name: Pengy (SSR)
characters.conditions: Consumes all P-Engy stacks; deals up to 999,999 Plain damage and knocks herself out
characters.notes: Deliberate sacrifice nuke; brings backline Evoker (Caim/Lobelia) to frontline immediately.

characters.name: Yodarha (SSR)
characters.conditions: Consumes 3 Triple Shroud stacks on Charge Attack (333,333 plain damage per stack)
characters.notes: Guaranteed 999,999 plain damage on Turn 1 ougi; ignores enemy defense.

characters.name: Gwynne
characters.conditions: Deals 3 hits of 400,000 plain damage (1.2M total) when HP is >= 76% (2 hits at 51-75%, 1 hit below 50%)
characters.notes: Consistently generates up to 1.2M plain damage on every Charge Attack.

characters.name: Kolulu (Summer)
characters.conditions: Auto-activates when HP is below 25% (Red HP) or upon enduring lethal damage

characters.name: Clarisse (Fire)
characters.conditions: Deals 1% to 5% of enemy's current HP as plain damage (capped at 710,000) and dispels 1 buff
characters.notes: Simultaneously counters both Plain Damage omens and Dispel omens.

characters.name: Catura
characters.conditions: Consumes charge bar to deal scaling plain damage to all foes
characters.notes: Team multi-attack buff and C.A. battery coupled with plain damage.

characters.name: Yodarha (Wind)
characters.conditions: Consumes Perpetual Flash stacks to deal plain damage nukes
characters.notes: Reliable plain damage skill for Wind grids.

characters.name: Clarisse (Light)
characters.conditions: Deals up to 710,000 plain damage + Dispels 1 buff; grants team Supplemental DMG with Dissolution charge

characters.name: Horus
characters.conditions: Deals 500,000 plain damage, grants C.A. charge bar, and inflicts Blind
characters.notes: Light charge attack looping enabler with plain damage utility.

characters.name: Lunalu (SSR)
characters.conditions: 100% guaranteed copy of an ally's damage skill (copies Threo's Ground Zero for duplicate 2.04M nuke)
characters.notes: Allows dealing 4.08M+ total plain damage in 1 turn when deployed with Threo.

characters.name: Black Knight
characters.conditions: Deals 500,000 plain damage and inflicts Delay on target
characters.notes: Controls boss diamonds while chipping plain damage.

mcClassesAndWeapons.name: Yamato (Row V Class)
mcClassesAndWeapons.mechanism: Take the Head (reduces omen cancel condition by 20% to 30%) and Seasplitter (instant omen cancel)
mcClassesAndWeapons.specialEffect: Bypasses or reduces required plain damage on any V2 cancelable omen.

mcClassesAndWeapons.name: Sword Master / Glorybringer + Disparia
mcClassesAndWeapons.mechanism: Mainhand Disparia Awaken skill consumes 30% HP to deal 30x (45x at 4★) current HP as plain damage
mcClassesAndWeapons.specialEffect: Deals 800,000 to 1,200,000 team-wide plain damage instantly on Turn 1.

mcClassesAndWeapons.name: Tormentor + Well-Worn Blade / Toxic Spike
mcClassesAndWeapons.mechanism: Consumes crafted secret gear items to deal up to 1,000,000 plain damage
mcClassesAndWeapons.specialEffect: On-demand repeatable plain damage without skill cooldown limitations.
